Thousands of lives are at stake as ordinary heroes try to stop a runaway train transporting toxic chemicals in this action-thriller starring Denzel Washington and Chris Pine!
Robert Clayton Dean is a successful Washington, D.C., attorney who -- without his knowledge -- is given a video that ties a top official of the National Security Agency to a political murder!

An asteroid the size of Texas is heading directly toward Earth. NASA's only option is to hire the world's foremost deep core oil driller and his roughneck team to land on the asteroid, drill into its surface, and drop a nuclear device in the core.
